name: ECKERT & ZIEGLER STR.-U.MED.AGI
summary: Eckert & Ziegler Strahlen- und Medizintechnik AG is a global provider of isotope technology for medical, scientific, and industrial applications. The company's business segments include isotope products, radiation therapy, and radiopharmaceuticals. Eckert & Ziegler is headquartered in Berlin, Germany.
